comparison.objective: Mount and aim two cardioid microphones as an ORTF stereo pair; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Dual microphone mounting, spacing/angle alignment, and aiming versus recessed-tool insertion, bimanual counterholding, collar adjustment, locking, and impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Record gives no spacing, angle, aiming tolerances, fastening criteria, or stability duration beyond the ORTF label. Candidate requires explicit energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and drift compliance.
comparison.reason: Audio-array geometric rigging is unrelated to empirical damping adjustment and setting-retention validation; missing ORTF rubric details do not create a plausible duplicate.
